text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync request — customer 'Lumina' asked for tenant-prefetch + per-tenant routing next quarter. Need runtime/infra/security alignment.
Priya Nair: Can you share launch criteria and hard dates? Also product priority vs other pilots?
Alex Chen: Targeting beta week of Aug 14. Launch criteria: latency SLOs (no >5% p95 regression), canary w/ 10 tenants, cost delta <15%. Must pass security review (SAML/KMS).
Dan Ortiz: Runtime note — per-tenant cache + prefix caching looks doable, but needs KV cache isolation work and a config flag. Estimate 3w dev + 1w integration.
Emily Wu: Infra: we have ~2 spare GPU slots in staging now, but prod burst capacity needs reservation. Dedicated capacity commit lead time ~6w.
Ryan Patel: Security: KMS integration ok, but need threat model/design review. Privacy review for tenant separation too. Can we scope to avoid cross-tenant KV leakage?
Alex Chen: Good call. Priya — is Dedicated required for beta or can we use hosted + fallbacks?
Priya Nair: Prefer hosted for beta to move fast. Product will accept stricter SLA if Dedicated required later. Can we plan hosted w/ conservative routing + forced degrade?
Dan Ortiz: Hosted + conservative routing works if we implement fallback policy in router (route to 'small' model variant when capacity low). Runtime changes: flag + router policy ~1w after cache work.
Emily Wu: We'll need a capacity plan: expected QPS per tenant, concurrency, token estimates. Product, can you provide traffic profile?
Alex Chen: Sending sample traffic curves now — link to doc. Peak ~2k tokens/sec across 10 tenants, avg ~600 tps, bursty mornings.
Ryan Patel: OK. We'll queue security review. If we scope beta to mask PII and keep KV TTL small, review is faster.
Priya Nair: Decision needed: prioritize cache isolation work (slower) vs ship with tenant-namespace prefix + monitoring (faster). Product prefers faster with monitoring.
Dan Ortiz: If monitoring-first path, require rollback plan and automated TTL purge. Need alerting on cross-tenant cache-hit anomalies.
Emily Wu: Infra action: I'll provision a staging cluster with reserved warm GPUs for canary. Can start this week if eng commits dates.
Alex Chen: Quick checklist: (1) Runtime cache isolation flag (2) Router fallback policy (3) Security threat model (4) Staging capacity reservation (5) Canary plan + monitoring dashboard. Owners?
Priya Nair: I'll own (5) and coordinate with customers. Alex will own product docs. Dan for (1)-(2). Ryan for (3). Emily for (4).
Dan Ortiz: I'll create a tech RFC with timeline and roll-forward/rollback steps.
Emily Wu: I'll open infra ticket to reserve capacity and give ETA EOD Thu.
infra-bot: Deploy pipeline check — staging cluster currently has 4 warm GPUs available. Note: production reservations require finance approval.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Let's do a 30m sync Fri 10am to confirm timelines. Ping here if blockers before then. :thumbsup:
